basics.name: Shruthi Kodati
basics.title: Software Engineer & Computer Science Graduate Student
basics.summary: Software Engineer and CS graduate student (MS, UIC - May 2026) with hands-on experience designing, building, and shipping secure, scalable full-stack systems, from React frontends and RESTful API design to distributed backend architecture and cloud deployment. Delivered 40% reduction in manual effort and 35% faster response times on production systems real users depend on daily.

experience.company: College of Nursing | University of Illinois Chicago
experience.role: Software Engineer / Full-Stack Developer, Graduate Assistant
bullets: Spearheaded greenfield development and cloud deployment of a live production web application using Python, Flask, RESTful APIs, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript on Render via Git/GitHub CI/CD, automating end-to-end clinical dietary workflows for 3+ active nursing research teams and eliminating 40% of manual processing effort across 500+ structured dietary records per workflow cycle.

Re-architected 12+ RESTful API endpoints by restructuring SQL query logic, introducing indexed relational schemas, and optimizing data pipeline throughput, achieving a 35% reduction in average API response time and hardening reliability under concurrent production load serving 10+ daily active users.

Engineered a responsive, accessible frontend with DOM-driven dynamic rendering, client-side form validation, and real-time user feedback across 8+ core workflow views, empowering non-technical clinical staff to confidently interact with complex structured data without engineering support.

Designed and implemented secure authentication and session management flows, multi-layer server-side input validation, and structured CRUD operations covering 10K+ managed database records, building the complete application stack to production engineering standards with defensible, maintainable architecture.

Owned the full CI/CD delivery lifecycle including pipeline configuration, zero-downtime version releases, Git branching strategy, and performance profiling, sustaining 100% production uptime across 6+ months of continuous active development.

Developed 6+ dynamic REST API endpoints for real-time data querying, structured aggregation, and clinical report generation, enabling nursing researchers to programmatically filter, access, and export structured dietary datasets directly from the live production system.

Partnered with nursing researchers and faculty across 10+ requirement sessions to elicit specifications, validate features, and drive rapid iteration cycles, delivering version-controlled zero-downtime production releases that 15+ active clinical users depend on daily.

Conducted systematic debugging, code reviews, and production performance profiling across the full application stack, proactively resolving 40+ critical bottlenecks and documenting all technical decisions to maintain engineering standards throughout the complete project lifecycle.

Debugged, tested, and deployed enhancements using Salesforce CLI, Git, and VS Code, improving feature release turnaround time by 20% through structured testing and version control.

projects.title: Cipher-Signal Protocol Encrypted Messenger
bullets: Implemented the complete Signal Protocol stack (X3DH key agreement + Double Ratchet algorithm) from scratch in Node.js and Socket.io, producing a zero-knowledge platform supporting 25MB encrypted file transfers across 12 file types with forward secrecy and post-compromise recovery enforced at the protocol layer.

Hardened security with Ed25519 SPK signature verification, 256-bit session tokens, rate limiting, and replay attack prevention, eliminating path traversal vulnerabilities via UUID-namespaced storage and guaranteeing exactly-once message delivery via an ACK-based persistent offline queue with deduplication.
Designed the full backend architecture across 3,000+ lines of cryptographic application code, covering key registration, prekey bundle exchange, session initialization, and message dispatch.

projects.title: Multi-Modal RAG for SEC 10-K Financial Document Analysis
bullets: Architected a two-stage RAG pipeline ingesting 150 SEC 10-K filings (8GB, 45K text chunks, 12K tables) with hybrid FAISS+BM25 retrieval and table row-sentence representation, achieving 85% Table Recall@5 and a 12-point Exact Match improvement over text-only baselines.

Deployed the production retrieval system (LLaMA 3.2, sentence-transformers, 8+ Flask API endpoints) with intelligent query routing and citation generation, attaining 96% faithfulness and 4.2s median latency across FinQA, DocFinQA, and FinDER benchmarks with full ablation studies across 3 evaluation datasets.

projects.title: SF Property Tax Analysis & Gentrification Risk Assessment
bullets: Constructed an end-to-end analytics pipeline processing 3.7M property tax records (6GB GeoJSON) across 93 San Francisco neighborhoods, implementing memory-optimized ETL with categorical encoding and streaming parsing that slashed data footprint by 87% (5.7GB to 733MB).

Surfaced 59.6% median property appreciation (2015 to 2023) via 15+ interactive Altair visualizations identifying high-risk displacement zones and quantifying COVID-19 housing market impact for urban planners and policymakers.

otherProjects.title: Systematic Benchmarking of Multiple Sequence Alignment Algorithms
bullets: Evaluated and benchmarked computational efficiency and alignment accuracy of five prominent Multiple Sequence Alignment (MSA) algorithms (Clustal Omega, MUSCLE, MAFFT, Kalign, and T-Coffee) using reference alignments from BAliBASE 3.0.
Analyzed resource usage (execution time and memory footprint) across 150+ protein sequence datasets, correlating algorithm complexity with sequence length and divergence levels.
Calculated Sum-of-Pairs Scores (SPS) and Column Scores (CS) using Python, developing reproducible data visualization dashboards with Altair and Pandas to select optimal aligners.

otherProjects.title: Chicago Traffic Crashes: Predictive Safety Analytics
bullets: Analyzed 938K crash records with 48 features, building ensemble models (Random Forest, XGBoost, Neural Networks) achieving 0.597 RMSE for injury prediction.
Discovered 90% pedestrian injury rate and identified highest-risk corridors.
Deployed interactive dashboards on GitHub Pages with Plotly/Folium; implemented DBSCAN clustering for geographic hotspot identification.

otherProjects.title: Fairness in Targeted Advertisements
bullets: Built comprehensive fairness evaluation framework addressing bias in targeted advertising by combining Meta's Ad Library (66K employment ads), FairJobs benchmark dataset (1M+ rows), and custom synthetic data.
Achieved 93.4% reduction in statistical parity difference while maintaining 99.2% accuracy, and improved Disparate Impact Ratio from non-compliant 0.70 to near-compliant 0.98.
Implemented multiple mitigation strategies including Reweighing, Adversarial Debiasing, and Threshold Optimization using Fairlearn and AIF360.
Published 11-page ACM research paper with mathematical formalization, ablation studies across three datasets, and statistical significance testing.
